activities.anchor: an argument structure any analytic philosopher would recognise
activities.caption: rebuild Shankara's argument
activities.name: eastShankaraOrder

config.prompt: Rebuild the Advaita argument for the deep self:
items: The body, feelings and even cognition are objects of awareness
What is observed cannot be the observer
The observer — pure awareness — must be other than all of them
That awareness is not individually yours but singular
The world of separate selves and objects is maya — misapprehended, like a rope seen as a snake
config.why: Liberation is not achieving something but realising what was always the case — knowledge is liberation, which makes the highest human project epistemic.

activities.anchor: The self is a pattern, like a flame passing candle to candle
activities.caption: pair the Buddhist terms with their work
activities.name: eastBuddhaMatch

config.prompt: The Buddha's diagnosis and Nagarjuna's sharpening — pair each term with its work:

pairs.right: no permanent self — the person is a causal stream of five aggregates
everything arises in dependence on conditions; nothing exists independently
empty of svabhava — intrinsic independent essence
things exist conventionally, as dependently originated — the doctrine targets essence, not existence

config.why: Real as process, empty as substance — and Yogacara pushes further inward, arguing the subject–object structure of experience is mind-constructed.

activities.anchor: what they lack is intrinsic independent being
activities.caption: find the faulty line — a gloss on emptiness
activities.name: eastEmptinessSpot

config.prompt: One line of this student's gloss on Nagarjuna is wrong — click it:
lines: Emptiness means nothing exists — Buddhist philosophy is nihilism.
Nagarjuna's target is essence, not existence.
Things exist conventionally, as dependently originated.
What is missing is svabhava — intrinsic, independent being.
Even emptiness itself is empty — a logical result, not despair.
config.correction: Emptiness is emptiness of svabhava: things exist conventionally; the doctrine denies self-contained substances, not the world.
config.why: Denying essence is not denying the world — it is denying that the world is made of self-contained substances.

activities.anchor: anyone seeing a child about to fall into a well feels immediate alarm
activities.caption: drag the divider — the human-nature split
activities.name: eastNatureCompare

config.prompt: Drag the divider — the split that still runs:

before.label: Mencius: sprouts innate
before.text: The sprouts of goodness are inborn — spontaneous alarm at the child at the well, before any calculation of advantage; cultivation grows the seedling.

after.label: Xunzi: built by ritual
after.text: Nature is unruly and goodness is artefact — built by ritual, teachers and institutions, the way a straight plank is steamed straight.

config.why: Modern moral psychology keeps finding evidence on both sides, which is why the argument still runs.

activities.anchor: carves the same ox for nineteen years
activities.caption: bet on what wu wei means
activities.name: eastWuweiPredict

config.q: "Wu wei" is often mistranslated as passivity. What does Zhuangzi's butcher illustrate?
choices: Withdrawal — the Daoist ideal is doing nothing
Effortless action — competence that has stopped struggling, the blade finding the joints
config.why: Maximum competence, not collapse — action that has stopped struggling against the grain of things, effort freed from forcing.

activities.anchor: they are the ones that break the stereotype entirely
activities.caption: file the two schools that break the stereotype
activities.name: eastJainSort

config.prompt: Two schools complete the picture — file each claim:

items.label: anekantavada — every object and truth has indefinitely many aspects, so every judgment is partial and should be stated as such
ahimsa — non-violence radicalised into a total ethic; through Gandhi, a consequential political idea of the twentieth century
perception is the only valid knowledge-source — inference always overreaches
the soul is nothing beyond the conscious body; ritual religion is priestcraft

config.why: Full-throated materialists, dualists, idealists and perspectivalists inside one tradition — the "Eastern mysticism" monolith dissolves on contact with the sources.

activities.anchor: The convergences are precise, not vague
activities.caption: pair each convergence with its content
activities.name: eastConvergeMatch

config.prompt: Where East and West genuinely meet — pair each convergence with its content:

pairs.right: the mind as "a bundle of perceptions" without a simple owner — Hume converges with the Buddha
categories depend on each other, not on hidden essences
who you are — son, teacher, friend — partly constitutes what you owe
first-person methods turned into third-person study, with instruments

config.why: Modern cognitive science's distributed self-models give the no-self an empirical foothold — the collaboration works where neither side pretends its methods can do the whole job.
